A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the classical string propagates in the background of a superspace, and the superstring equations are equivalent to the supergravity field equations.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in a superspace, the local fermionic symmetry can be used as a gauge symmetry to remove the ghosts from the spectrum.
the supergravity equations of motion are a consequence of the fermionic gauge symmetry, and not vice versa.
, for a given superstring theory, the supergravity equations are a necessary condition for the absence of ghosts, but not sufficient.
